name: mobile-inspector-fixes
description: Mobile: inspector thumbnail + no horizontal overflow (Pro radial array), catalog minimize, toolbar swap, tap-to-place ghost+pill.

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: select-item
steps.eval: (()=>{const st=window.__store.getState(); const rid=st.roomEditor.roomId; const it=st.items.find(i=>true); if(it){ st.setSelectedItemIds([it.id]); }})()

steps.name: measure-overflow
steps.eval: (()=>{const b=document.querySelector('.inspector .panel-body'); console.log('OVERFLOW_CHECK '+JSON.stringify({scrollW:b?b.scrollWidth:null, clientW:b?b.clientWidth:null, overflows: b? b.scrollWidth>b.clientWidth+1 : null}))})()
